_note: Hand-written cook builds. Every build flips what its champion is known for (Nico, 2026-10-16: keep only builds like Melee Bomb Man Ziggs). build_data.py adds augment text, China win rates and simulator numbers and writes data.js. The first `core` augments decide the build's tier; the rest are flex picks. `augment_text` replaces the generated text for augments whose tooltip numbers the game data doesn't fill in.

augment_text.With Haste: Gain Move Speed equal to a share of your Ability Haste.

builds.title: Melee Bomb Man
builds.why: Ziggs gives up his bombs-from-a-mile-away identity and walks up to stab people. Draw Your Sword turns his range into AD, Health, Attack Speed and Lifesteal, and his passive Short Fuse still blows up on his next melee hit. Dual Wield, Firebrand and Juiced pile on-hit magic damage onto every swing.
builds.play: Walk at them. Throw a bomb only when you're already standing on them.

builds.title: Noxian Sniper
builds.why: The reverse of Melee Bomb Man. Melee champions get more from the range augments than ranged ones (75, 150 and 250), so all three together add 475 range and put Darius's autos at 650, the same as Caitlyn's. He stacks Hemorrhage from across the fight, and Typhoon fires a second shot at another target.
builds.play: Stand at the back and auto. Walk up only to Guillotine whoever has five stacks.

builds.title: Tiny Marksman
builds.why: Veigar's whole game is stacking infinite Ability Power. escAPADe turns every point of it into 0.6 bonus AD (plus 15% more AD), so his Q stacks and even Rabadon's Deathcap now feed his auto attacks. Dual Wield, Critical Rhythm and It's Critical make him a crit marksman with a yordle hat.
builds.play: Farm Q stacks like normal, then right-click everyone. Cage still works.

builds.title: Starchild Sniper
builds.why: The healer stops healing and becomes the team's marksman. Scopiest Weapons adds 150 range on top of her 550, Dual Wield and Deft make her shoot fast, and the full crit build does the rest. The simulator's item search keeps finding that enchanters out-damage their normal builds with crit items.
builds.play: Silence them with E, then auto from 700 range. W is for emergencies only.

builds.title: No Requiem
builds.why: Karthus is the map-wide ultimate, and Back To Basics seals it for good. In return his Q, W and E deal 35% more damage with 70 Ability Haste, and Infernal Conduit, Recursion and Magic Missile turn Lay Waste into a nonstop burning machine gun.
builds.play: Spam Q. When your team pings for Requiem, tell them it's sealed.

builds.title: Mundo Can't Regen
builds.why: Mundo's identity is Health regen, and Vampirism turns all of it off: no regen, no healing from allies, and his ultimate's regen does nothing. He lives on Omnivamp instead (25% from Vampirism, more from Goredrink, Juicebox and Ominous Pact), and Ominous Pact makes every cast cost Health.
builds.play: Hit things to stay alive. Don't press R expecting it to help.

builds.title: Giant Teemo
builds.why: The tiny scout who hides in bushes is now the biggest thing on the map. Goliath and Tank Engine grow him, Celestial Body adds 1,500 Health, and Heavy Hitter makes every dart hit for a share of it. He can no longer hide anywhere.
builds.play: Walk down the middle of the lane. Shrooms are still invisible; you are not.

builds.title: Paper Malphite
builds.why: The armor-stacking rock buys zero armor. Glass Cannon cuts 30% of his Health for extra true damage, Giant Slayer makes him tiny, and the full crit build turns his autos into the damage. His ultimate is still a knock-up, it just comes from a pebble.
builds.play: Unstoppable Force into their backline, then auto. Don't get hit.
